narrative.overview: This is a refinement of the established paper, ink, amber, Georgia, and sans-serif identity. It makes one image, one action, and one result easy to follow. Thin rules, quiet controls, short instructions, and progressive detail replace the simulator's dense operational shell. The source-built candling symbol is decorative; the image preview shows the user's selected file.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink, amber, Georgia, and sans-serif identity.
One image, one action, and one result.
Thin rules, quiet controls, short instructions, and progressive detail.

rules.name: The Next-Action Rule
rules.body: Show one clear next action. Keep supplementary image tips and saved-record metadata behind native disclosures. Account setup uses brief hints beside the relevant field.

rules.name: The Compact-Authority Rule
rules.body: Keep research status next to the result and the appearance-only limitation visible in the workspace footer. Compact wording must preserve the factual boundary.

dos: Do preserve the paper/ink/amber identity, short instructions, restrained serif hierarchy, and flat ruled surfaces.
Do keep the next action obvious and supplementary details collapsed until needed.
Do keep Analyze and History as the essential production destinations and move mobile focus to a newly returned result.
donts: Don't reintroduce the simulator's navigation, dense gate ledgers, or square-only controls into production by following the historical sections below.
Don't turn an appearance estimate, polished login, UI review, or local software check into a food-safety, security-audit, or physical-readiness claim.
